projects.title: Computer Vision
projects.summary: Custom object-detection models trained on industrial datasets, then pushed down to embedded hardware.
projects.description: Fine-tuned YOLOv8, YOLOv11, RT-DETR and D-Fine on task-specific datasets. Used OpenCV and OpenVINO to make inference fit the deployment target.
highlights: Trained and fine-tuned computer vision models on custom datasets.
Built an OpenCV/OpenVINO deployment path for constrained hardware.
Multi-threaded the whole process for the drone (Input channel // Output channel)

projects.title: Stock Handler
projects.summary: A custom computer-aided logistics management system for turbomachinery operations — from requirements to Azure.
projects.description: Built using Frappe Framework around the reality of the workshop: parts, stock movements, and the people who keep them moving.
highlights: Benchmarked open-source ERP options, then built a module on Frappe Framework.
Designed and engineered the full structure with Python, JavaScript and MariaDB.

screens.caption: Stock Handler example with the framework I used, I can't show you the result due to privacy policy of course.

projects.title: LLVM IR Vulnerability Detection
projects.summary: A memory-safe feature extractor and a deep-learning pass over LLVM IR, covering source, build systems and the supply chain.
projects.description: Extracts structural features from LLVM IR with a Rust tool, then trains a Python model to flag vulnerabilities across the software supply chain.
highlights: Rust extractor built for speed and memory safety.
Feature pipeline over source and build-system IR.
